title: Slavedriver Menlo
summary: Menlo repeatedly forces refugee groups into battle.
overview: Menlo repeatedly forces refugee groups into battle.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Keep a tank available for refugees while the main tank holds Menlo.
A new refugee group is called every minute, cycling through five groups.
Idle refugees can be drawn into the fight between calls, so watch the whole area.
